title: Iran conflict events -> short UAE
hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] Iran-Gulf dyad event count 20d z-score > 1 leads UAE ETF returns lower by 1-2 days (-); trade short UAE 3d [gdelt.irn.conflict_events -> finance.UAE.log_return]
message: Weak: r=-0.18 n=390 but heuristic validity 0; short-UAE rule 62 trades, all-sample excess +0.02%/trade, pre-war fit negative (-0.13%), war OOS +0.32%/trade hit 57% (21 trades); actionability 6.18, not robust

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.irn.conflict_events rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short UAE next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] Iran fight-event count 20d z-score > 1 leads UAE ETF returns lower by 1-3 days (-); tighter subset of conflict events, trade short UAE 3d [gdelt.irn.fight_events -> finance.UAE.log_return] (parent: R2-0081)
